A zero-row fetch skips delisting entirely (rows retained, log.warn).
Keep-list = EVERY externalId the registry served this run, including
rows that failed the length pre-check or parsing, and rows the client
rejected as unplaceable (a live registry row must never be deleted
just because this run could not store or place it).
User-added shelters (source USER) are never touched.
Every run (OK / FAILED / NOT_MODIFIED / SKIPPED) writes ONE data_imports
audit row - best-effort (an audit failure never breaks the import).
